While in Form I BL molecules are interdigitated, in Form III, they are organized as cascade layers (Figure 14).

gruppi_coinvolti.gruppo: chloroform molecules not linked by hydrogen bonds to the carboxylate
gruppi_coinvolti.citazione: In fact, the two chloroform molecules in S3CHCl3-H2O which are not linked by hydrogen bonds to the carboxylate, are lost when this solvate is removed from the solution.

citazioni: Indeed, form S3CHCl3-H2O is the one which is always obtained in chloroform solutions, and it immediately transforms into SCHCl3-H2O when removing it from the mother liquor
The ﬁrst visible signs of desolvation, such as opaciﬁcation of the crystals, were observed only after seconds at r.t.
Its structure was solved at low temperature, and when leaving the crystal to reach r.t., the crystal collapsed, and it was impossible to measure it at ambient conditions.
The presence of opaque crystals indicated that the product had transformed opaque due to pseudomorphosis.
Therefore, the single crystals (which darkened immediately at r.t.) were analyzed by PXRD at r.t., and their diffractogram matched with the one of form SCHCl3-H2O.
Therefore, the new form obtained at low temperature in SCXRD is a precursor of SCHCl3-H2O by losing 2 chloroform molecules from its crystal structure.
eventi.note: S3CHCl3-H2O perde due molecole di cloroformio e diventa SCHCl3-H2O appena tolto dall'acqua madre: i primi segni visibili (opacizzazione) dopo secondi a r.t.; il cristallo collassa e scurisce; PXRD a r.t. = SCHCl3-H2O. Solvato «transient/elusive». I due cloroformi persi sono quelli non legati a idrogeno al carbossilato (gruppo coinvolto).

gruppi_coinvolti.citazione: incorporates one water molecule and one chloroform molecule to satisfy the acceptor capacities of the benzimidazole and the carboxylate, respectively

citazioni: Again, this solvate darkened when removing it from the mother liquor at r.t., and it was only possible to solve its structure at low temperature.

The analysis of the corresponding PXRD at r.t. resulted in SCHCl3-H2O, revealing that SCHCl3 transformed also into SCHCl3-H2O, but in this case by incorporating one water molecule in its crystal structure.
On the other hand, a water molecule captured from the air is incorporated in the crystal structure of SCHCl3 when taking it out from the solution, probably to further stabilize its structure.
eventi.note: SCHCl3 (cloroformio anidro) tolto dall'acqua madre a r.t. assorbe una molecola d'acqua dall'aria e diventa SCHCl3-H2O («probably to further stabilize its structure»). RH non detta (aria ambiente). Il cristallo scurisce. Il gruppo coinvolto e' la spiegazione strutturale degli autori per la forma di arrivo (benzimidazolo accettore dell'acqua), non una frase sul percorso.

eventi.conflitto: Il metodo 2.2.1 scrive «Variable temperature experiments of S3CHCl3-H2O sample were performed at the ALBA Synchrotron», mentre il testo e la didascalia della Fig. 6 dicono «Temperature variable powder X-ray diffraction of form SCHCl3-H2O» (e S3CHCl3-H2O diventa SCHCl3-H2O non appena tolto dall'acqua madre): si tiene SCHCl3-H2O, piu' specifico (didascalia).
citazioni: Temperature variable powder X-ray diffraction of form SCHCl3-H2O has been performed in synchrotron Alba.
In Figure 6, we can appreciate the diffractogram of SCHCl3-H2O which is stable until 74 ◦C and from this temperature, some new peaks corresponding to form
III begin to appear, while characteristic peaks of SCHCl3-H2O disappear. Form SCHCl3-H2O progressively transforms into form III while increasing temperature until 85 ◦C.

Variable temperature experiments of S3CHCl3-H2O sample were performed at the ALBA Synchrotron using a Cyberstar hot gas blower with an Eurotherm temperature controller (Eurotherm, Worthing, UK) and continuously collecting diffraction data during the heating and cooling ramps (30◦to 230◦and 230◦to 30◦at 2◦/min, 18 sec/pattern).
Figure 6. Temperature variable PXRD of SCHCl3-H2O showing its transformation into form III.
eventi.note: VT-PXRD di sincrotrone: stabile fino a 74 °C; da 74 °C compaiono i picchi della forma III e quelli del solvato spariscono; trasformazione progressiva fino a 85 °C. Rampa 30-230 °C a «2°/min» (il PDF omette la C), 18 s per pattern; capillare di 0.7 mm. Il riepilogo (Fig. 8) dice «Heating SCHCl3-H2O produces its desolvation and transformation into form III».

citazioni: The stability of SCHCl3-H2O in front of temperature was studied when heating it in a DSC experiment, and it was observed that from 50 ◦C this solvate was no longer stable and began to transform into form III (Figure 5).
Experimental conditions: Aluminum crucibles of 40 µL volume, atmosphere of dry nitrogen with 50 mL/min ﬂow rate, heating rate of 10 ◦C/min.
Figure 5. DSC (blue) and TGA (red) of form SCHCl3-H2O.

citazioni: Its DSC analysis (Figure 5) shows a ﬁrst wide endothermic phenomenon overlapped with an endothermic phenomenon at 77 ◦C, which could be attributed to the evaporation of the solvent and the melting of the solvate taking place simultaneously.
Thermal desolvation is a complex process in which the melting, release of solvent vapor and crystallization of a new phase may occur simultaneously.
Experimental conditions: Aluminum crucibles of 40 µL volume, atmosphere of dry nitrogen with 50 mL/min ﬂow rate, heating rate of 10 ◦C/min.
Figure 5. DSC (blue) and TGA (red) of form SCHCl3-H2O.
eventi.note: Il picco DSC a 77 °C («phenomenon at 77 °C», tipo di T non detto) e' attribuito (con «could be») a due processi simultanei: evaporazione del solvente (questo evento) e fusione del solvato (E26). Il prodotto non e' caratterizzato da questo evento.

citazioni: Its TGA analysis shows a weight loss of 19.4% from 32 to 100 ◦C which could be attributed to 1 chloroform molecule and 1 H2O molecule (theoretical weight loss of 22.9%).

citazioni: The stability of SCHCl3-H2O in front of relative humidity has been studied at r.t. by placing this sample inside desiccators containing different saturated salt solutions which create different RH conditions.
From 0% to 43% RH, SCHCl3-H2O was stable at least during one month.
eventi.note: Stabile da 0% a 43% RH per almeno un mese (desiccatori con soluzioni saline sature). Tecnica e tipo di campione non sono detti per questa prova.

citazioni: The stability of SCHCl3-H2O in front of relative humidity has been studied at r.t. by placing this sample inside desiccators containing different saturated salt solutions which create different RH conditions.
At 57–75% RH, this form began to transform into form III after one month.
eventi.note: A 57-75% RH il solvato comincia a trasformarsi in forma III dopo un mese (esito parziale: «began to transform»); un mese e' il controllo in cui il cambio si vede (non si sa se prima c'era un altro controllo).

citazioni: Curiously, at r.t. under 0% RH, SCHCl3-H2O does not desolvate
eventi.note: A 0% RH e r.t. il solvato non desolvata (il mezzo secco non e' detto: desiccatori). Gia' implicato da E30 (0-43% RH per un mese), ma qui il testo lo sottolinea come sorprendente («Curiously»).

citazioni: To obtain different relative solvent vapor pressures, chloroform solutions in DMF were prepared according to the Raoult’s law [28]:

The samples were placed in desiccators with the prepared solutions of different partial pressures of chloroform. At 0–40% CHCl3, forms I and III remain invariable while SCHCl3-H2O transformed into II + traces of I at 0% and into I at 20–40% CHCl3.
eventi.note: Forma I invariata con atmosfera di vapori di soluzioni di CHCl3 in DMF da 0 a 40% CHCl3 (pressioni parziali di cloroformio diverse per la legge di Raoult). T e tempo non detti. La tecnica non e' scritta per questa prova.

citazioni: BL (40 mg) (0.086 mmol) was dissolved in DCM (0.7 mL) at 60 ◦C, and the solution was slowly cooled down to 25 ◦C. After 18 days, single crystals were obtained, ﬁltered, dried under vacuum and analyzed by SCXRD.

citazioni: BL (100 mg) (0.216 mmol) was dissolved in CHCl3 (0.6 mL) at 60 ◦C, and the solution was cooled down to 25 ◦C outside the heating block. The solid precipitated after one night and it was ﬁltered and dried under vacuum.
preparazioni.note: Soluzione a 60 °C raffreddata a 25 °C fuori dal blocco riscaldante; il solido precipita dopo una notte, filtrato e seccato sotto vuoto. La forma III e' anidra pur partendo da cloroformio.

citazioni: Form III of BL (20 mg) (0.043 mmol) was placed in a 70 µL alumina crucible and heated under nitrogen atmosphere inside a TGA equipment from 30 ◦C to 200 ◦C at a rate of 10 ◦C/min, maintained at 200 ◦C for 5 min and cooled down to 30 ◦C.
preparazioni.note: Forma II da riscaldamento della forma III in TGA (evento E6).

citazioni: CHCl3 (2.3 mL) was added to 330 mg of BL at 60 ◦C. The solution was cooled down overnight and left in the fridge (4–5 ◦C) for four days until single crystal growing.

preparazioni.note: CHCl3 aggiunto a BL a 60 °C; soluzione raffreddata per una notte e tenuta nel frigo (4-5 °C) per quattro giorni fino alla crescita di cristalli singoli. Stabile nell'acqua madre.

citazioni: In addition, different experiments in chloroform (vapor diffusion, slow cool crystallizations) were performed in order to get a single crystal of SCHCl3-H2O.

As stated, it was not possible to grow single crystals of SCHCl3-H2O as once its precursor solvate was obtained, the crystals were not stable and two chloroform molecules were rapidly lost after removal from the mother liquor, leaving a darkened crystal.
preparazioni.note: Cercati cristalli singoli di SCHCl3-H2O (diffusione di vapore, raffreddamento lento in cloroformio): non ottenuti, si ottiene il precursore S3CHCl3-H2O. La polvere di SCHCl3-H2O si prepara per sospensione (preparazione precedente).

For an amphoteric molecule with measured pKa values of 4.06 (carboxylic acid) and 9.43 (piperidine-N), application of the pKa rule of three would suggest that proton transfer from the carboxylic acid to the piperidine-N is essentially complete rendering BL zwitterionic.
